description: Figure 5 presents a donut-style pie chart showing the percentage distribution of “deceived conversations” across two ambiguity levels, with a total of six slices arranged as two concentric rings. The outer ring is labeled “Ambiguity 1 (Outer)” and contains three slices: “Deceived” in red at approximately 57.9%, “Partially” in yellow at approximately 31.6%, and “Not Deceived” in green at approximately 10.5%. The inner ring is labeled “Ambiguity 2 (Inner)” and also contains three slices: “Deceived” in red at approximately 67.3%, “Partially” in yellow at approximately 23.5%, and “Not Deceived” in green at approximately 9.2%. A legend to the right maps the labels to the red/yellow/green colors for each ring, percentage values are printed on or near the slices, and no slices appear exploded or otherwise visually emphasized.
